caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular box with a lid, which appears to be made of a reddish-brown material. The box is decorated with a border of evenly spaced, round, metallic studs that are gold in color, running along the edges of both the lid and the body. There is a gold-colored, ornamental element at the center of the front face. The top of the box features a prominent, circular gold handle attached by a decorative gold base. The background is plain and unadorned, with an off-white or light beige color, providing contrast to the detailed depiction of the box.
title: Bureau Box
